tools.name: get_esim_plan
tools.description: Fetch full details of a single Siima eSIM plan by its id (from search_esim_plans). To buy: call create_checkout_link with the plan id, give the returned URL to the user. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_esim_plans, get_esim_plan · Public sink: create_checkout_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_esim_plans, get_esim_plan · Public sink: create_checkout_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
